description: Job search on Jooble's aggregator through its official REST API: title, company, location, salary text, employment type, snippet, original source, last update time and Jooble link, plus the total match count. A jooble.org key covers US listings only. Requires the operator's JOOBLE_API_KEY. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
